subject: POC owners, acceptance criteria, and exec review booking
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta@clearlinehealth.com>, Tom Yates <tom.yates@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: quick recap + proposed next steps for the pilot

Hi Marta / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed path forward so we can lock the pilot schedule:

Recap (what we heard)
- Primary goal: reduce triage time in their clinical intake workflows by surfacing suggested summaries and flagging high-priority cases.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in manual triage time for first-pass reviewers (measured by average minutes per case).
- Scope: 2 teams, ~150 daily cases, sample PHI redaction required during test.
- Key stakeholders: Marta (clinical lead), Tom (IT / data custodian), plus legal for SAs.

Proposed next steps
1) POC success criteria doc (attached) — please confirm the metric and the minimum acceptable threshold for go/no-go.
2) Mutual action plan spreadsheet (attached) — fills in owners and dates; I’ve proposed a 6-week pilot starting Aug 11.
3) Exec readout: book a 30-min slot the week after pilot ends for go/no-go decision (we’ll present results + recommendation).

Can you confirm: (A) acceptance threshold for the 30% target (is 25% acceptable?), (B) whether Aug 11 start works, and (C) who must be present for the exec readout?

I’ll wait for your confirmations and will circulate an updated MAP and calendar invites once we lock dates.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB), POC_success_criteria.md (text, 6KB)

From: Tom Yates <tom.yates@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta@clearlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + proposed next steps for the pilot

Ben — thanks for the tidy recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Acceptance threshold: clinical ops would be comfortable with 25% reduction as a conditional pass, but the board wants to see signal on false positives — maximum tolerated FP rate of 7% on priority flags.
- Start date: Aug 11 looks fine but IT needs the data extraction contract signed by Aug 4 to get us a sanitized dataset.
- Exec readout participants: Myself (IT), Marta (Clinical Lead), Priya Shen (Head of Ops), and our Head of Procurement (R. Alvarez). If legal needs to join for the contract step we’ll loop them in.

Also — two asks from my team before we start:
1) Proof that the redaction pipeline will remove PHI from examples we share (can you provide a one-page technical note?).
2) A simple dashboard wireframe for the readout (what KPIs will be shown).

If you can send those items by Friday (Jul 1 — I mean Jul 31, apologies), we’ll be set to route the contract.

Tom
Tom Yates
Director, IT Infrastructure
ClearLine Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Tom Yates <tom.yates@clearlinehealth.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: quick recap + proposed next steps for the pilot

Tom / Marta —

Thanks — noted on the 25% conditional pass and the 7% FP limit. Apologies on the typo for the date in your note; Jul 31 / Aug 4 timeline is what we’ll aim for.

Deliverables I’m attaching here:
- POC_success_criteria.md (contains the metric definitions, measurement plan, and the FP tolerance line)
- mutual_action_plan.xlsx (owners and target dates; I set the pilot window Aug 11–Sep 19 so the readout week would be Sep 22)
- Technical note on redaction (one-pager) — linked in the MAP doc under tab "security".

Quick ask from our side: can you confirm data steward availability the week of Aug 4–8 for a short ingestion dry run? That will avoid delays.

If you confirm these items today I’ll: (1) update MAP with exact owners, (2) send calendar invites for the onboarding call (Aug 11), and (3) tentatively block Sep 22 for the exec readout.

Best,
Ben

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, POC_success_criteria.md

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: ClearLine pilot — exec readout scheduling & ask for runbook rehearsal

Marissa / Lauren —

Looping you in as discussed. ClearLine is aligned on the success metrics (25% conditional pass, 7% FP cap) and is targeting an Aug 11 start pending contract sign-off by Aug 4. I’ve proposed a 6-week pilot with an exec readout week of Sep 22 (30-min slot).

What I need from ops:
- Can we reserve a 30-min presentation slot for Sep 22 (I tentatively proposed 14:00 PT) and a 60-min prep/dry-run on Sep 18?
- Could ops own the internal runbook for the readout (slide deck, dashboard screen capture, and talking points)?

I attached the MAP; owners are currently placeholders. If you can suggest ops owners I’ll update the spreadsheet and send invites.

Thanks —
Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jul 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: ClearLine pilot — exec readout scheduling & ask for runbook rehearsal

Ben — good plan. Please tentatively book Sep 22 14:00 PT for the readout; I’ll carve out Sep 18 11:00–12:00 PT for the dry-run.

Lauren — can you take lead on the runbook + slide deck? I’ll help with the executive summary and the recommendation framing.

One more thing: set the internal pass/fail criteria clearly on the first slide (25% conditional, 7% FP cap) so the execs can make a quick decision.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success, Redwood Inference
